changeSet.author: liquibase

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_partitioned_table pt WHERE pt.partrelid = 'fdr3.payment'::regclass AND pg_get_partkeydef(pt.partrelid) = 'RANGE (flow_date)'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_class idx JOIN pg_namespace ns ON ns.oid = idx.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_index ix ON ix.indexrelid = idx.oid LEFT JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid = idx.relam WHERE ns.nspname = 'fdr3' AND idx.relname = 'payment_pay_date_flow_id_flow_date_idx' AND NOT COALESCE( idx.relkind = 'I' AND am.amname = 'btree' AND ix.indrelid = 'fdr3.payment'::regclass AND NOT ix.indisunique AND ix.indnatts = 3 AND ix.indnkeyatts = 3 AND ix.indpred IS NULL AND ix.indexprs IS NULL AND ix.indoption::text = '0 0 0' AND pg_get_indexdef(idx.oid, 1, true) = 'pay_date' AND pg_get_indexdef(idx.oid, 2, true) = 'flow_id' AND pg_get_indexdef(idx.oid, 3, true) = 'flow_date', FALSE )

changeSet.comment: Create the archive payment parent index without building indexes on existing partitions. Partition indexes are built concurrently and attached by subsequent changesets. Parent validity is checked after all attachments.
